Game Overview

Catch the Square puts players into a clicker experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Catch the Square is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Catch the Square?

Catch the Square is a free clicker game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Catch the Square free to play?

Yes, Catch the Square is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
